sop_title: Clearing Temporary Files to Resolve Disk Full on orders-api
purpose: To resolve disk space exhaustion caused by accumulation of temporary files in the orders-api deployment.
when_to_use: When the orders-api disk is 100% full and generating OSError No space left on device errors.
prerequisites: kubectl access to the shop namespace
Permissions to execute commands in the orders-api deployment

steps.instruction: Check the disk usage to confirm the problem.
Clear temporary files to free up disk space.
steps.expect: Temporary files older than one day are deleted.

steps.instruction: Check the disk usage again to confirm the fix.

verification: Run df -h on /var/lib/shoplite to confirm available space.

rollback.instruction: Deleted temporary files cannot be automatically restored; verify application functionality and regenerate necessary temporary files if required.
rollback.expect: Application functions normally after clearing space.

sop_change: Created new SOP since no internal SOP covered disk space issues.
short_description: Disk full error on orders-api due to accumulated temporary files.
problem_statement: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device: '/var/lib/shoplite/tmp/receipt-8812.pdf' occurred because /var/lib/shoplite reached 100% capacity.
impact: orders-api could not write temporary PDF receipt files, leading to application errors.
trigger: Accumulation of files in the temporary directory exceeding available disk space.
immediate_resolution: Deleted temporary files older than one day using the find command.
root_causes: Uncleaned temporary files accumulating in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp over time.

timeline.event: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device occurred and disk usage was confirmed at 100%.
Engineer asked about safety of step 2 and received confirmation.

action_items: Implement automated cleanup for temporary files in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp.
